name: performance-profile-layout
goal: Performance profile has space above it, equal measurement row heights, and no output-size row when no output is declared.

evidence: Give the overview measurement card a normal stack gap above it, equal label/value row heights, and hide the no-output placeholder while retaining real compiled target values and reasons.

Existing visual-overview tests only required one full-width card and explicitly required Emitted size for units without output. Extend the same current/selected-commit scenarios with card-gap, equal-row-height and applicable-target assertions at three widths; extend existing formatter and details tests to preserve real output rows.

b02b88f6 fails all three browser widths with named assertions for zero card spacing, unequal row heights and an inapplicable output row. Unit tests also fail the missing target metadata.
